detectorTypes.DOM: Reads the rendered DOM and computed styles in one page.evaluate. No interaction. Deterministic.
detectorTypes.Playwright: Drives the page: resize, click, type, press keys, follow links, watch network and timing. Deterministic given the same page.
detectorTypes.Screenshot Analysis: Compares or inspects screenshots (focus rings, grayscale, saliency, balance). Pixel checks are deterministic; interpretation is advisory.
detectorTypes.Lighthouse: Mobile Lighthouse run(s) under stated simulated conditions; lab values only. Field data (CrUX) is separate.
detectorTypes.Axe: axe-core rule results (violations, passes, incomplete), plus Sugam checks that extend it.
detectorTypes.AI Judgement: A model is handed the rule (id, title, evaluationPrompt) as data and a page-context slice. It must quote evidence that exists in the context. Never confirms a failure alone.
detectorTypes.Hybrid: Two or more of the above in a fixed order: deterministic extraction or measurement first, judgement only for what remains.
detectorTypes.None (human session): Needs a person, a participant or an assistive-technology session. The engine reports it as not run.
detectorTypes.None (rollup): A summary of other rules. Zero weight, no independent result.

results.observed_pass: The check ran and the condition holds.
results.observed_failure: The check ran and the condition fails, with evidence.
results.needs_human_review: A pattern was found that only a person can decide, or a model flagged it.
results.inconclusive: The check ran but the evidence cannot decide.
results.not_applicable: The rule does not apply to this page.
results.not_run: The check could have run but did not (analyzer failed, no AI key, needs a person).

evidenceRecord.note: Raw observations are kept for every tested state.

couldNotVerifyRule: "Could not verify" is returned whenever the detector did not run, the target was not found, the evidence was ambiguous, or a required input (goal, design system, owner evidence, field data) was not supplied. It is never rounded up to pass and never to fail.
